Short title and commencement

The Basic Democracies (Amendment) Ordinance 1966
THE BASIC DEMOCRACIES (AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE 1966
ORDINANCE No. VII OF 1966
(Approved by the National Assembly of
Pakistan on the 28th November 1966, see Gaz. of P., Ext., p. 197 (Dacca).)
[15th October, 1966]
An Ordinance further to amend the Basic Democracies Order, 1959
WHEREAS it is expedient -further
to amend the Basic Demo cracies Order, 1959, for the purpose hereinafter
appearing P.O. No. 18 of 1959;
1. Short title and commencement.-(1) This Ordinance may be called
the Basic Democra cies (Second Amendment) Ordinance, 1966.
(2) It shall come into force at
once.

Amendment of Article 3, P.O. No. No. 18 of 1959

The Basic Democracies (Amendment) Ordinance 1966
THE BASIC DEMOCRACIES (AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE 1966
ORDINANCE No. VII OF 1966
(Approved by the National Assembly of
Pakistan on the 28th November 1966, see Gaz. of P., Ext., p. 197 (Dacca).)
[15th October, 1966]
An Ordinance further to amend the Basic Democracies Order, 1959
WHEREAS it is expedient -further
to amend the Basic Demo cracies Order, 1959, for the purpose hereinafter
appearing P.O. No. 18 of 1959;
2. Amendment of Article 3, P.O. No. No. 18 of 1959. In the Basic
Democracies Order, 1959, in Article 3, in clause (1), in sub-clause (28), after
the word "Government" at the end, the words "but does not
include a member of the National Assembly or of a Provincial Assembly"
shall be added and shall be deemed always to have been so added P.O. No. 18 of
1959.

Saving

The Basic Democracies (Amendment) Ordinance 1966
THE BASIC DEMOCRACIES (AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE 1966
ORDINANCE No. VII OF 1966
(Approved by the National Assembly of
Pakistan on the 28th November 1966, see Gaz. of P., Ext., p. 197 (Dacca).)
[15th October, 1966]
An Ordinance further to amend the Basic Democracies Order, 1959
WHEREAS it is expedient -further
to amend the Basic Demo cracies Order, 1959, for the purpose hereinafter
appearing P.O. No. 18 of 1959;
3. Saving. Any election, before the commencement of this Ordinance,
of a person who is a member of the National Assembly or of a Provincial
Assembly, as an elected member of a District Council or a Divisional Council
under the Basic Democracies Order, 1959, shall be deemed to have been held
under that Order as amended by this Ordinance ; and no such election shall be
called in question merely on the ground that, at the time when such election
was held, such person was not qualified for election as such elected member
P.O. No. 18 of 1959.
